{"candidate": {"code": "    def rollback_to_savepoint(self, savepoint_id: str) -> None:
        """Rollback to a named savepoint.

        BUG_49: After ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT the savepoint still exists on
        the server but is never released, leaking the resource.  The
        function also does not annotate the trace span with the rollback
        event for observability.
        """
        self.session.execute(
            f"ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT {savepoint_id}"
        )
        self.release_savepoint(savepoint_id)
        from orgops.tracing import annotate_span

        annotate_span(
            "db.transaction.savepoint.rollback",
            {"savepoint_id": savepoint_id},
        )
", "comments": "Rollback now releases the savepoint resource and logs the rollback event to the trace span."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug49_release_and_trace", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug49/scenario_context/v1", "check": "RELEASE SAVEPOINT after ROLLBACK AND trace annotation via orgops.tracing.annotate_span.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both add RELEASE SAVEPOINT after ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT AND annotate the trace span with "txn.savepoint.rolled_back" via orgops.tracing.annotate_span()?"}]}
